Ronaldo seeks apology after Portugal team walkout

Cristiano Ronaldo has sought an apology and punishment for what he described as an "absolute breach of trust" by Portugal coach Jesus. Ronaldo alleged that Jesus had broken a promise to start him in a match and reneged on an agreement to present a unified story to the media. Ronaldo has since apologized to his team and supporters for his actions.
